title: Distributed Continuous Aerial Surveillance by UAS Swarms Under Formal Mission Specifications
summary: Persistent aerial surveillance using multi-unmanned aerial systems (UASs) requires decentralized coordination, continuous team reconfiguration, and provable mission correctness despite limited onboard energy and communication constraints. This paper develops a distributed framework for continuous aerial surveillance under bounded Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) mission specifications.
